description: Read the raw headers of a received email: SPF, DKIM and DMARC results, alignment, the delivery path and delays. Use when someone pastes headers and asks why a message went to spam or failed authentication.

headers.description: The raw email headers (the part above the message body), copied from "Show original" in Gmail or "View source" in Outlook.

name: analyze_email_headers

fromDomain.description: The sender domain from the From header.

hops.description: How many servers the message passed through.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a free web tool on pipefire.ai.

totalSeconds.description: Delivery time end to end, when the timestamps allow.

title: Email header analyzer
